text:
maria: Quick heads up — kicking off quarterly access radar for staging clusters. Need owners to confirm admin entitlements for all staging resources (clusters, S3 buckets, KMS keys) by EOD next Thu.

DANA: Is this just staging or do we include dedicated-preview nodes? Also do we scope KMS admins separately?

maria: staging + dedicated-preview. KMS admins: yes, separate check — ops-bot will dump grants. We'll use the least-priv bench to surface obvious over-perms.

ops-bot: automated dump scheduled: `staging-kms-grants-20260321.json` (uploaded)

lia: Can someone post the quick jq to find ownerless iam bindings? I can run the remediation script but need list.

sam: use: `jq -r '.bindings[] | select(.members|length==0) | .role' grants.json` — but better: `jq -c '.bindings[] | select(.members==null or .members==[])' grants.json`

jeff: For evidence: I'll collect audit log snippets for any admin role use over the last 90 days and attach to the ticket. Any preferred format? csv ok?

maria: CSV is fine. Please include KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt and iam.serviceAccounts.actAs events. Put links in the ticket: infra/SEC-6789.

DANA: If someone is OOO next week, can we extend the owner deadline? I can help triage exceptions if needed.

maria: yes — leave a note in the ticket with proposed exception and justification; we'll approve short-term ones and schedule follow-up for role slimming.

lia: quick FYI — found 3 service accounts with broad roles on staging that look legacy. I'll mark them as 'candidate for prune' and run canary removal in staging-canary first.

sam: For canary removal: make sure to add a rollout flag: `flag rollout.force=false && rollout.window=2h` in the job. Also capture `auditlog.trace_id` so we can rollback if errors.

maria: Solid. Let's not cut any KMS grants without a backup + key rotation plan. Jeff, lia, can you coordinate on the rotation playbook?

jeff: On it. Will draft rotation steps and attach to the ticket before EOD.

maria: Thanks everyone. Ping me if you want to own exception approvals. :thumbsup:
